steps.text:
I've built the sponsor card, it passes validation with no errors, and the latest version is recorded. Nothing has been saved to your NoaCG library; the host does that from the record.

**What it looks like:** a small, solid dark-navy card in the bottom-right corner with an orange top edge. "CON EL APOYO DE" sits on top with three small dots that show which logo is up. Below is one fixed area where the three logos take turns, crossfading every 6 seconds. The card is fully opaque, so a busy, colourful finish line never shows through it.

**Your three logos:** each one sits on its own backing panel inside the card.
- **White wordmark:** goes on a dark panel.
- **Black wordmark:** goes on a white panel.
- **Very wide logo:** shown whole, never cropped, using almost the full width of the card.
- **Choosing the panel:** it's set automatically from the logo's colours. I tested this with stand-in white, black and wide logos, and it chose correctly over a video background. Some playout setups won't let it read the logo file; then it falls back to the white panel, which would hide your white wordmark. So for the white one, set **Logo N backing** to "Dark card" in the Data panel once per show...
